personality_one_liner: A highly readable, professional, and function-first interface that lets the studio's schedule, bookings, and financial data remain the visual hero.

spacing.rule: Use generous padding around content. Ensure lists and POS rows have comfortable vertical rhythm. Do not cramp touch targets.

do's: Apply to bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind.
Apply to sticky headers on the Booking Calendar and POS screen.
Use over the hero studio image on the PIN login screen.
dont's: Never apply to form inputs or list rows.
Do not use on dense numerical POS report cards.

screens.name: PIN Login
screens.purpose: Secure entry for staff and admins using a custom numpad.

states.error: Shake animation on PIN dots, red error text 'PIN Salah'.

screens.layout: Full-bleed background photo of the photo studio (dark scrim) with CASADELLA logo. Custom 3x4 numpad pinned to the bottom 1/2 of the screen. Display 4-6 empty dots for PIN entry.

screens.name: Dashboard & POS Summary
screens.purpose: Overview of today's schedule, quick actions, and daily POS income/expense for admins.

states.loading: Skeleton cards for financial summaries and schedule list.
states.empty: Illustration of empty calendar with 'Belum ada jadwal hari ini'.
states.error: Inline error banner 'Gagal memuat data' with retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky header (glass). Top section: POS Summary (Income, Expense, Turnover) in a horizontal scroll or 2-col grid. Middle section: Quick Actions (Clock-in/out, New Booking). Bottom section: Stacked list of today's upcoming bookings. Bottom tabs for navigation.

screens.name: Booking Calendar
screens.purpose: Manage time slots (09:00-20:00) and assign packages.

states.empty: Empty state illustration on dates with zero bookings.
states.error: Toast or banner for failed slot loading.

screens.layout: Top sticky date picker (horizontal scroll of days). Segmented control to toggle between Schedule View and List View. Main content: Vertical list of 15-min intervals. Booked slots appear as colored tiles (brandTertiary) taking up proportional height based on package duration. Bottom sheet for creating a new booking (selecting package -> auto-adjusts duration).

screens.name: Package Selection & Payment
screens.purpose: Select photo packages and manage DP (Deposit) / Pelunasan (Balance).
screens.layout: Stacked list organizing packages. Sticky primary CTA 'Lanjut ke Pembayaran' fixed at the bottom. Payment screen uses a bottom sheet to enter DP amount, calculating remaining balance. IDR currency formatting mandatory.

screens.name: Admin Reports & Settings
screens.purpose: View daily/monthly/yearly income, manage staff, and system settings.
screens.layout: Segmented controls for Daily/Monthly/Yearly. Large metric cards for Net Income (Revenue - Expenses). Stacked list for staff roles/attendance tracking. Settings rows with tinted icon containers (brandTertiary squares).

instructions_to_main_agent: Language MUST be Bahasa Indonesia across the entire app (e.g., 'Uang Muka/DP', 'Pelunasan', 'Jadwal', 'Laporan').
Currency formatting MUST use IDR (Rp) for all POS and payment views.
Implement Role-Based Access Control logic: Staff (Read-only), Admin 1/2 (Edit bookings/payments), Super Admin (Settings/Manage Staff). Mock this context.
Time slots must be dynamically generated from 09:00 to 20:00 in 15-minute intervals. Package selections should block out appropriate intervals automatically.

Design the Logo text 'CASADELLA Photo Studio' using a gradient from #0B3D66 to #2A8BC4 if transparent PNG is not available (since image fetch for logo failed). Use an Ionicons 'aperture' or 'camera-outline' icon to represent the shutter mark.
Apply 'iOS-Native Clean' principles: high readability, no muddy colors, native spring animations, and a white/navy palette.
Ensure 'Sticky Primary CTA' pattern is used on scrollable pages like Package Selection and Checkout.
Any time text overlays the hero_studio_bg image (like on the Login screen), apply a vertical top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) to guarantee WCAG contrast.
